questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.
Ram failed initially but after a few years, he _________ in every field.
questions.solution:
B)'Succeeded'का use होगा क्योंकि "succeeded" का अर्थ होता है सफल होना, जो कि 'failed' का सही antonym (विलोम शब्द) है। sentence में बताया गया है कि राम शुरू में असफल हुआ लेकिन बाद में हर क्षेत्र में सफल हो गया, इसलिए 'succeeded' यहाँ सही विकल्प है। जबकि 'enjoyed' का अर्थ है आनंद लेना, 'reserved' का अर्थ है सुरक्षित रखना, और 'elevated' का अर्थ है ऊपर उठाना, जो इस context में सही नहीं हैं।
'Succeeded'will be used because it means to achieve success, which is the correct antonym of 'failed.' The sentence mentions that Ram initially failed but later succeeded in every field, making 'succeeded' the right choice here. Whereas, 'enjoyed' means to take pleasure, 'reserved' means to keep something for a specific purpose, and 'elevated' means to raise up, which don't fit in this context.
Succeeded(verb) – Achieve the desired aim or result, accomplish, triumph, win. सफल होना
Antonym:Failed(verb) – Be unsuccessful in achieving one's goal, collapse, lose. विफल होना
Enjoyed(verb) – Take delight or pleasure in something. आनंद लिया
Reserved(adjective) – Slow to reveal emotions or opinions, withdrawn, shy. संकोची
Elevated(verb) – Raised or lifted up, promoted, uplifted. उन्नत
